name: Seeking the Kor Gem
summary: Ulric Frostveil, a Forsaken in Ashenvale, sees your search for a Kor Gem as familiar work for Alliance spellcasters. He points you toward Blackfathom Deeps, where naga still use the gems.

sections.title: A Gem in Ashenvale
sections.body: Ulric asks you to bring him a Kor Gem from the ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, north of Ashenvale. He says the naga below still use the gems, which can empower magical weapons and implements. He warns you not to go alone.

sections.title: Ulric's Interest
sections.body: Ulric recognizes corruption in the gem and says he can dispel the evil the naga witches infused into it. He asks whether you would sell it to him for his academic pursuits instead.

faq.answer: Ulric Frostveil is a Forsaken in Ashenvale who asks you to bring him a Kor Gem.

faq.q: Where can I find a Kor Gem?
faq.answer: Ulric directs you north to Blackfathom Deeps, where naga still use Kor Gems.

faq.q: What are Kor Gems used for?
faq.answer: Kor Gems are sometimes used to empower magical weapons and implements.

faq.q: Why does Ulric want a Kor Gem?
faq.answer: Ulric asks you to bring him a Kor Gem, and says he may value it for his academic pursuits.
The naga in Blackfathom Deeps still use Kor Gems.
